source_quotes.source_title: Cheniere Signs Long-Term Sale and Purchase Agreements to Supply QatarEnergy with LNG through 2054
source_quotes.quote: Through Cheniere Energy Partners, L.P. (NYSE: CQP), we are developing an expansion of the existing Sabine Pass Liquefaction Project (“SPL Project”) with an expected total peak production capacity of up to approximately 20 mtpa of LNG (the “SPL Expansion Project”), inclusive of estimated debottlenecking opportunities, which would grow the total production capacity of the SPL Project to over 50 mtpa of LNG. We expect to execute the SPL Expansion Project in a phased approach. The first phase is expected to include a single train, Train 7, and a boil-off gas re-liquefaction unit, along with supporting infrastructure and tie-ins to the existing Sabine Pass LNG terminal, and has an expected total production capacity of over 6 mtpa of LNG, inclusive of estimated debottlenecking opportunities. historical_events.facts: Cheniere Announces Substantial Completion of CCL Stage 3 Project, Production and Export of 5,000th LNG Cargo. Cheniere celebrated its 5,000 th LNG cargo with the loading of the Yari LNG carrier, which departed Sabine Pass on August 29 th en route to Asia. Since the production of its first LNG cargo in 2016, Cheniere has now supplied more than 340 million tonnes of LNG to markets worldwide, and the Company’s LNG platform has grown to represent over 10% of total global LNG capacity. Cheniere Energy, Inc. Gulf Coast, with a total combined production capacity of approximately 56 mtpa of LNG in operation and an additional approximately 5 mtpa of expected production capacity under construction. historical_events.facts: Cheniere Highlights 10 Years of LNG Exports in 2025 Corporate Responsibility Report. N0.title: Cheniere Signs Long-Term Sale and Purchase Agreements to Supply QatarEnergy with LNG through 2054
N0.body:
HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Cheniere Energy, Inc. (“Cheniere” or the “Company”) (NYSE: LNG) announced today that its subsidiaries,…

HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Cheniere Energy, Inc. (“Cheniere” or the “Company”) (NYSE: LNG) announced today that its subsidiaries, Sabine Pass Liquefaction, LLC (“SPL”) and Corpus Christi Liquefaction, LLC (“CCL”), have each entered into long-term liquefied natural gas (“LNG”) sale and purchase agreements (“SPA”) with QatarEnergy to supply a total of 4 million tonnes per annum (“mtpa”) of LNG through 2054.

Through Cheniere Energy Partners, L.P. (NYSE: CQP), we are developing an expansion of the existing Sabine Pass Liquefaction Project (“SPL Project”) with an expected total peak production capacity of up to approximately 20 mtpa of LNG (the “SPL Expansion Project”), inclusive of estimated debottlenecking opportunities, which would grow the total production capacity of the SPL Project to over 50 mtpa of LNG. We expect to execute the SPL Expansion Project in a phased approach. The first phase is expected to include a single train, Train 7, and a boil-off gas re-liquefaction unit, along with supporting infrastructure and tie-ins to the existing Sabine Pass LNG terminal, and has an expected total production capacity of over 6 mtpa of LNG, inclusive of estimated debottlenecking opportunities. In May 2026, the lump sum, turnkey engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contract with Bechtel Energy, Inc. (“Bechtel”) for the first phase of the SPL Expansion Project was signed, and Bechtel was released to commence early engineering and procurement under a limited notice to proceed (LNTP).

Investors Randy Bhatia 713-375-5479 Frances Smith 713-375-5753

historical_events.title: U.S. exports of LNG to the Caribbean near record highs in 2025 - U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA)
historical_events.facts: U.S. exports of LNG to the Caribbean near record highs in 2025 - U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA). The United States exported approximately 0.3 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) of liquefied natural gas (LNG) to destinations in the Caribbean in 2025, the second-highest volume since the first LNG cargo departed Sabine Pass in 2016, according to the U.S. Department of Energy’s LNG Exports and Re-Exports Details .

historical_events.title: Cheniere Announces Substantial Completion of CCL Stage 3 Project, Production and Export of 5,000th LNG Cargo
historical_events.facts: Cheniere Announces Substantial Completion of CCL Stage 3 Project, Production and Export of 5,000th LNG Cargo. Cheniere celebrated its 5,000 th LNG cargo with the loading of the Yari LNG carrier, which departed Sabine Pass on August 29 th en route to Asia. Since the production of its first LNG cargo in 2016, Cheniere has now supplied more than 340 million tonnes of LNG to markets worldwide, and the Company’s LNG platform has grown to represent over 10% of total global LNG capacity. Cheniere Energy, Inc. Gulf Coast, with a total combined production capacity of approximately 56 mtpa of LNG in operation and an additional approximately 5 mtpa of expected production capacity under construction. Cheniere is also pursuing liquefaction expansion opportunities and other projects along the LNG value chain.

historical_events.title: Cheniere Highlights 10 Years of LNG Exports in 2025 Corporate Responsibility Report
historical_events.facts: Cheniere Highlights 10 Years of LNG Exports in 2025 Corporate Responsibility Report. The report celebrates a defining milestone for Cheniere: 10 years since the first cargo of LNG was exported from its Sabine Pass Liquefaction terminal in Louisiana, a shipment that launched a new energy era for the United States as a major supplier of LNG to the world. “Nearly 5,000 LNG export cargoes later, we take great pride in the fact that our exports have helped reshape global LNG trade dynamics, providing unprecedented liquidity and flexibility to the market, enabling energy supply to reach customers and markets when and where it is needed most.” Gulf Coast, with a total combined production capacity of approximately 55 mtpa of LNG in operation and an additional over 6 mtpa of expected production capacity under construction or in commissioning, inclusive of estimated debottlenecking opportunities.

N0.title: Cheniere Signs Long-Term Sale and Purchase Agreements to Supply QatarEnergy with LNG through 2054
N0.body:
HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Cheniere Energy, Inc. (“Cheniere” or the “Company”) (NYSE: LNG) announced today that its subsidiaries,…

HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Cheniere Energy, Inc. (“Cheniere” or the “Company”) (NYSE: LNG) announced today that its subsidiaries, Sabine Pass Liquefaction, LLC (“SPL”) and Corpus Christi Liquefaction, LLC (“CCL”), have each entered into long-term liquefied natural gas (“LNG”) sale and purchase agreements (“SPA”) with QatarEnergy to supply a total of 4 million tonnes per annum (“mtpa”) of LNG through 2054.

Through Cheniere Energy Partners, L.P. (NYSE: CQP), we are developing an expansion of the existing Sabine Pass Liquefaction Project (“SPL Project”) with an expected total peak production capacity of up to approximately 20 mtpa of LNG (the “SPL Expansion Project”), inclusive of estimated debottlenecking opportunities, which would grow the total production capacity of the SPL Project to over 50 mtpa of LNG. We expect to execute the SPL Expansion Project in a phased approach. The first phase is expected to include a single train, Train 7, and a boil-off gas re-liquefaction unit, along with supporting infrastructure and tie-ins to the existing Sabine Pass LNG terminal, and has an expected total production capacity of over 6 mtpa of LNG, inclusive of estimated debottlenecking opportunities. In May 2026, the lump sum, turnkey engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contract with Bechtel Energy, Inc. (“Bechtel”) for the first phase of the SPL Expansion Project was signed, and Bechtel was released to commence early engineering and procurement under a limited notice to proceed (LNTP).
